audience.text: Developers needing fast, lightweight image format identification and metadata extraction in .NET applications without full decoding or external dependencies.

capabilities.text: Detects 14 image formats by reading signature bytes only, returning an ImageFormat enum value without full parsing.
capabilities.title: Format detection

capabilities.text: Reads width, height, bit depth, and frame count directly from format-specific header fields for PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, WEBP, ICO, TIFF, PSD, EMF, WMF, DICOM, DJVU, AVIF, and HEIC/HEIF.
capabilities.title: Header metadata extraction

capabilities.text: Has no required third-party package dependencies; all format parsing is implemented natively within the library.
capabilities.title: Zero dependencies

capabilities.text: Returns partial ImageInfo with only Format set for malformed or truncated files instead of throwing exceptions.
capabilities.title: Robust error handling

capabilities.text: Targets netstandard2.0 and net8.0, enabling use across a wide range of .NET implementations.
capabilities.title: Multi-target framework support

capabilities.text: Provides both synchronous and asynchronous entry points (Probe/ProbeAsync, ProbeFile/ProbeFileAsync) for non-blocking I/O.
capabilities.title: Async support

limitations.text: Only performs format detection and header parsing; does not decode, render, edit, or convert pixel data.
Frame count is real only for GIF, ICO, TIFF, and multi-page DJVU; other formats report fixed 1.
Classic non-placeable WMF is detected but not dimensioned because its header lacks bounding rectangle.
DICOM parsing stops at the first undefined-length element, such as a sequence or encapsulated pixel data.
CDR support is planned but not yet implemented; no CdrFormatHandler exists in the current source tree.

problems_solved.text: Eliminates the need to fully decode images just to determine format and basic properties like dimensions and bit depth.
Provides format detection and header parsing for less common formats like PSD, EMF/WMF, DICOM, DJVU, AVIF, and HEIC/HEIF in a single library.
Enables unattended processing of untrusted input by returning partial results instead of throwing exceptions on malformed files.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Imaging FOSS for .NET is a zero-dependency .NET library for image format detection and header probing without decoding pixel data.

uncertainties: Whether the library supports all DICOM transfer syntaxes beyond Implicit VR Little Endian and Explicit VR Little/Big Endian.
How the library handles AVIF grid images where the primary item association is ambiguous or missing.
Whether the library supports HEIC/HEIF variants beyond those explicitly listed in the README.
The exact behavior when probing a non-seekable stream that cannot be fully buffered.
Whether the library handles truncated multi-frame formats beyond reporting partial results.
How the library handles DJVU files that are indirect (multi-file) bundles rather than bundled DJVM.
Whether the library supports AVIF files with non-standard major brand combinations beyond avif/avis and mif1/mif2.
The exact set of formats supported beyond the 14 explicitly listed in the documentation.

workflows.name: Detect format from file
workflows.text: Call ImageProbe.DetectFormat(byte[]) or DetectFormat(Stream) to identify an image format using only signature bytes.

workflows.name: Probe file metadata
workflows.text: Call ImageProbe.ProbeFile(string) or Probe(byte[]) to read width, height, bit depth, and frame count from the file header.

workflows.name: Asynchronous probing
workflows.text: Use ImageProbe.ProbeFileAsync(string) or ProbeAsync(Stream) to avoid blocking on I/O in ASP.NET or UI threads.

workflows.name: Count frames in multi-frame formats
workflows.text: Probe returns real frame counts for GIF, ICO, TIFF, and multi-page DJVU by walking their container structures.
